adv.name: Hallowed Archer
adv.desc: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.
adv.mot: Focus fire, obey, reposition, volley

f.t: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked _Guilty_ by a High Seraph.
**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

adv.name: Hallowed Soldier
adv.desc: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.
adv.mot: Obey, outmaneuver, punish, swarm

f.t: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
While the Soldier is flying, **spend a Fear** to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adv.name: High Seraph
adv.desc: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god's will.
adv.mot: Enforce dogma, fly, pronounce judgment, smite

f.t: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
While the Seraph is flying, **spend a Fear** to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

**Spend a Fear** to make a target _Guilty_ in the eyes of the Seraph's god until the Seraph is defeated. While _Guilty_, the target doesn't gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a _Guilty_ target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

**Mark a Stress** to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked _Guilty_. Targets who fail take **4d6+12** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.
Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

adv.name: Kraken
adv.desc: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.
adv.mot: Consume, crush, drown, grapple

f.t: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, **mark a Stress** to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

**Spend a Fear** to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d6+9** physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.
When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adv.name: Oracle of Doom
adv.desc: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.
adv.mot: Change environment, condemn, dishearten, toss aside

f.t: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.
When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

**Spend a Fear** to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take **2d20+4** direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.
Once per day, **spend 2 Fear** to summon **2d4** Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.
When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.
When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal **2d10+4** physical damage.

adv.name: Outer Realms Abomination
adv.desc: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.
adv.mot: Demolish, devour, undermine

f.t: When the Abomination attacks, roll **2d4** and use the result as their attack modifier.
When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

**Spend a Fear** to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become _Unstuck_ from reality until the end of the scene. When an _Unstuck_ target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.
When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by **1d20**. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

adv.name: Outer Realms Corruptor
adv.desc: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.
adv.mot: Confuse, distract, overwhelm

f.t: When a PC takes damage from the Corruptor, they lose a Hope.
**Mark a Stress** to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

adv.name: Outer Realms Thrall
adv.desc: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.
adv.mot: Destroy, disgust, disorient, intimidate

f.t: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adv.name: Volcanic Dragon: Obsidian Predator
adv.desc: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.
adv.mot: Defend lair, dive-bomb, fly, hunt, intimidate

f.t: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.
The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **4d6+4** physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and _Vulnerable_ until their next roll with Hope.

If the Obsidian Predator is flying, **mark a Stress** to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **2d10+6** physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.
When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.

adv.name: Volcanic Dragon: Molten Scourge
adv.desc: Enraged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.
adv.mot: Douse with lava, incinerate, repel Invaders, reposition

f.t: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of **d6s** equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes **4d8+1** physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

**Spend a Fear** to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge's scales, filling the area within Very Close range with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d6+6** physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 HP.

When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll a **d10**. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within Far range. All targets in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10+4** physical damage, mark **1d4 Stress**, and are _Vulnerable_ until they clear a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.
When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from an attack within Very Close range, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals **2d10+4** direct physical damage to the attacker.
When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them.

adv.name: Volcanic Dragon: Ashen Tyrant
adv.desc: No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so. As the lava settles, it's ground to ash like the dragon's past foes.
adv.mot: Choke, fly, intimidate, kill or be killed

f.t: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
**Mark a Stress** instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.
While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.
When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can't lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take **2d20+2** physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

**Spend a Fear** to smash the ground and kick up ash within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

_Countdown (1d12)._ **Spend a Fear** to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10+10** physical damage and are _Restrained_ by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

adv.name: Perfected Zombie
adv.desc: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.
adv.mot: Consume, hound, maim, terrify

f.t: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.
PCs can't spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.
**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are _Vulnerable_ until their next rest.
When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can **spend a Fear** to add the Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

adv.name: Zombie Legion
adv.desc: A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh.
adv.mot: Consume brain, shred flesh, surround

f.t: When the Legion has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d6+5** physical damage instead.
The Legion has resistance to physical damage.
The Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Legion takes Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.
